title: Fourteen-hour closing-low dip above the two-hour long average

source.title: Larry Connors Double 7 Strategy (StrategyQuant), via lab hypothesis H-020

rule_summary: Work on two-hour blocks aligned to even UTC hours, built from finished hourly bars and used only after the block ends; orders go at the next hourly open. Buy when a block closes above the mean of the last 200 block closes and at or below the lowest block close of the last seven blocks, nothing open. Sell when a block closes at or above the highest block close of the last seven blocks. Stop two percent under the fill. New buys only in blocks starting 00:00 to 16:00 UTC; anything open is sold at the 23:00 UTC hourly open or after twelve hours.
mechanism: A pullback to a seven-block closing low inside a larger uptrend is a short-lived oversold state; sellers are forced or impatient, and price tends to return to the recent closing high within hours. Parent numbers kept, only the block length shrinks from a day to two hours. Expected gross move about 0.7% on winners; a design estimate.
